method.step1_fighting_words: Run Fighting Words (log-odds ratio) on CoT-ON reasoning vs CoT-OFF responses for 100 ARC-Easy examples with Qwen3-0.6B.
method.step2_cliff_detection: Identify the score cliff: top-1281 tokens score 4.0660, rank-1281 drops to 2.7515 (gap=1.3145). All tokens above the cliff form the metacognitive cluster.
method.step3_treetok_expansion: Run treetok TokenClusterer (Levenshtein distance=1) over the full Qwen3-0.6B vocabulary (151,669 tokens). For each seed token in the top-1281 cluster, collect all cluster-mates — capturing morphological variants (case, inflection, punctuation attachment) not present in the original Fighting Words cluster.
